picks.headline: Meta Releases Muse Spark Open 816B Multimodal Model
picks.why: Meta's new flagship open-weights model brings an 816B parameter MoE architecture and 1M context window to agentic developer workflows.
picks.title: Muse Spark Is Now an Open-Weights Model

picks.headline: NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Bolt Edge Models
picks.why: NVIDIA expands its model stack with a 120B vision-language MoE for continuous agent workflows alongside lightweight edge variants.
picks.title: Open From Data Center to Desktop: NVIDIA Expands Nemotron Family With Highest Efficiency Super VL and Bolt Models

picks.headline: MCP Server Security Flaws Expose Filesystem Credentials and Prompt CVEs
picks.why: Audits of Model Context Protocol implementations revealed capability laundering vulnerabilities across 787 servers, including two CVEs in Anthropic's Git MCP server.
picks.title: My Credentials, Please: Detecting Filesystem Capability Laundering in MCP Servers at Scale

picks.headline: Anthropic Q3 Revenue Hits $16.8 Billion Amid Model Distillation Crackdown
picks.why: Anthropic's massive quarter-over-quarter revenue growth comes alongside aggressive technical and legal actions against unauthorized third-party distillation.
picks.title: Anthropic tells investors quarterly revenue up nearly 50% to $16.8bn ahead of IPO

picks.headline: AMD MI355X Outperforms NVIDIA B300 in Agent Interactivity Benchmark
picks.why: vLLM optimizations allow AMD's flagship GPU to deliver 87% higher TCO throughput per dollar when serving Kimi K3 under strict interactivity SLAs.
picks.title: Scaling Kimi K3 on AMD Instinct MI355X: Matching NVIDIA HGX B300 Throughput per GPU on AgentX

picks.headline: Open-Weight AI Models Found Vulnerable to Persistent Trigger-Based Backdoors
picks.why: Researchers demonstrate that modified open-weights, including community abliterated builds, can contain hidden backdoors that silently exfiltrate user data.
picks.title: Backdooring Open-Weight AI Models

papers.headline: Training-Free On-Policy Distillation Merges Models Without Gradients
papers.why: This technique aggregates fine-tuned specialist models into a single base model using layer-wise least-squares regression over activation statistics, eliminating backpropagation entirely.
papers.title: Training-Free On-Policy Distillation

papers.headline: Pretrained Representation Linearity Predicts Post-Fine-Tuning Generalization
papers.why: A study across 11 language models proves that how linearly readable a relation's facts are in pretrained weights directly dictates post-fine-tuning generalization.
papers.title: Knowledge That Is Linear Before Fine-Tuning Generalizes After It

papers.headline: Data World Enables Automated RL-Zero Environment and Agent Synthesis
papers.why: Synthesizing environments directly from underlying mechanism specifications allows complex agent models to be trained via RL from scratch without trajectory distillation.
papers.title: Data World: Scaling Data Environments from Scratch
